# Dr. Sajini's Dental Clinic

Official website: https://drsajinidentalclinic.com

## About

Dr. Sajini's Dental Clinic is a dental clinic in Kochi, Kerala, India. The clinic is located at:

- X/530A Ishaan's Arcade, near Chakkanaad Temple, Chullickal, Kochi, Kerala 682005
- Phone: +91 8089793344
- Email: drsajinisdentalhospital@gmail.com
- Opening hours: Mon - Tues: 6.00 am - 10.00 pm; Sunday Closed
